/bin/bash -lc "cat > storage/evaluator_test.go <<'EOF'
package storage

import (
 \"context\"
 \"testing\"

 flipt \"github.com/markphelps/flipt/rpc\"
 \"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert\"
 \"github.com/stretchr/testify/require\"
)

func TestEvaluatorRuleRankAndResponse(t *testing.T) {
 ctx := context.Background()
 flag, err := flagStore.CreateFlag(ctx, &flipt.CreateFlagRequest{Key: t.Name(), Enabled: true})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 first, err := segmentStore.CreateSegment(ctx, &flipt.CreateSegmentRequest{Key: t.Name() + \"_first\"})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 second, err := segmentStore.CreateSegment(ctx, &flipt.CreateSegmentRequest{Key: t.Name() + \"_second\"})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 _, err = ruleStore.CreateRule(ctx, &flipt.CreateRuleRequest{FlagKey: flag.Key, SegmentKey: second.Key, Rank: 2})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 _, err = ruleStore.CreateRule(ctx, &flipt.CreateRuleRequest{FlagKey: flag.Key, SegmentKey: first.Key, Rank: 1})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 requestContext := map[string]string{\"name\": \" Alice \"}
 resp, err := evaluatorStore.Evaluate(ctx, &flipt.EvaluationRequest{FlagKey: flag.Key, EntityId: \"entity\", Context: requestContext})
 require.NoError(t, err)
 assert.True(t, resp.Match)
 assert.Equal(t, first.Key, resp.SegmentKey)
 assert.Empty(t, resp.Value)
 assert.Equal(t, requestContext, resp.RequestContext)
 assert.NotEmpty(t, resp.RequestId)
 require.NotNil(t, resp.Timestamp)
}

func TestEvaluatorComparisonNormalization(t *testing.T) {
 assert.True(t, matchesString(constraint{Operator: \"EQ\", Value: \" Alice \"}, \" Alice \"))
 assert.True(t, matchesString(constraint{Operator: \"PREFIX\", Value: \" Al \"}, \" Alice \"))
 assert.True(t, matchesString(constraint{Operator: \"SUFFIX\", Value: \" ice \"}, \" Alice \"))
 match, err := matchesNumber(constraint{Operator: \"GTE\", Value: \" 2.5 \"}, \" 3.0 \")
 require.NoError(t, err)
 assert.True(t, match)
 _, err = matchesNumber(constraint{Operator: \"EQ\", Value: \"1\"}, \"not a number\")
 require.Error(t, err)
 match, err = matchesBool(constraint{Operator: \"TRUE\"}, \" TRUE \")
 require.NoError(t, err)
 assert.True(t, match)
 _, err = matchesBool(constraint{Operator: \"TRUE\"}, \"not a boolean\")
 require.Error(t, err)
}

func TestEvaluatorBucketBoundary(t *testing.T) {
 request := &flipt.EvaluationRequest{FlagKey: \"flag\", EntityId: \"entity\"}
 bucket := int(crc32Num(request.EntityId, request.FlagKey))
 selected, d := evaluate(request, []distribution{{VariantKey: \"first\"}, {VariantKey: \"second\"}}, []int{bucket, bucket + 1})
 assert.True(t, selected)
 assert.Equal(t, \"first\", d.VariantKey)
}
EOF
gofmt -w storage/evaluator_test.go
GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test ./storage ./server"
